_comment: Single source of truth for the per-date programmatic series. index_from and index_to bound what /moon/:date and /void-of-course-moon/:date will chain-link at all; roll_back_days and roll_forward_days bound which of those dates are indexable, counted from today at request time. api/_seo/crawl.py must carry the same four values (bin/check-seo.py enforces it). Since 2026-10-21 the sitemap lists no per-date URLs: a committed sitemap cannot roll, so every date in it expired. The hubs carry the rolling links instead (bin/gen-internal-links.py writes them; the hub pages roll them forward in the browser).
